# API-derived demo fixtures

Run `node services/api/scripts/generate-demo-snapshot.mjs` from the repository root. The script creates an isolated in-memory demo API, customer and four member sessions, then uses authenticated HTTP calls to create, assign, accept, start, submit, confirm, dispute and record a demo settlement. All returned states, events, totals and amounts come from server responses. An injected clock runs the workflow at evening service hours (19:45 through 21:15, Asia/Shanghai); availability is published as 18:00–23:30 windows. It writes the operator snapshot, mobile in-progress order and member-preview responses from the same run. Ledger timestamps use the same injected clock. No database state or balance is injected. All identities are fictional; no real payment or bank transfer occurs. Tokens are omitted.
